entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: sum/avg-mixed-or subquery input is %T with %s sample kind
entries.rationale: mixedRel is the successful result of lowerSumOrAvgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, whose only successful combination is combineMixedAggregateBranches returning a VectorSetOp with Mixed set. VectorSetOp.RowType therefore publishes SampleKindMixed; any other kind means that internal postcondition changed.
